name: access.py
summary: Data, walks and rules: fake data, snapshot/live loaders, lookups, graph walks, 29 rule checks (24-28 on table activity, 29 Streamlit app exposure), Activity views (activity, query_sql, app_exposure, app_use, warehouse_use), what_if, diff. No Streamlit import.

name: server.py
summary: FastAPI JSON API over access.py (make_app) and serve()/serve_csv() reused by st_react.py; PAGES, ROUTES, host/origin checks.

name: cache.py

name: app.py
summary: Streamlit entry: page setup, 'component did not load' hint, runs st_react.app().

name: st_react.py
summary: React app (web/dist-st) as one Streamlit component; answer() routes its API calls to server.py.

name: ui.py
summary: Presentation constants sent in /api/meta: TOKENS, node styles, PCLASS, TYPE_ICON, HELP, psort.

name: run.py
summary: Launcher: web (server.py) or streamlit (app.py), --fake, --direct/--objects, --port.

name: run_sql.py
summary: Runs the '-- name:' statements of a sql/ file with &NAME filled from settings.local.sql (or settings.sql).

name: docs/make_readme.py
summary: Fills generated parts of README.html between <!--map:NAME--> markers (overview, flow, rules).

name: test_access.py
summary: Walker / rule / cache / live / perf tests on fake data; reruns itself with ROLE_PREFIXES=ZF_,ZT_.

name: test_server.py
summary: Every endpoint on fake data via FastAPI TestClient; read-only, same-site, bundles fresh, Streamlit bridge.

name: test_sql.py

name: web/src/App.tsx
